visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a visually appealing close-up shot of a steaming bowl of fish noodles, featuring thick slices of fish and red goji berries. A man in a professional white chef's coat, with the name 'Jerry' embroidered in red, is shown eating the noodles with great enthusiasm. He uses wooden chopsticks to lift a large portion of noodles and fish, smiling broadly with his eyes squinted to show satisfaction. The setting is a brightly lit studio kitchen with a clean aesthetic and a gray brick-patterned wall in the background. (2) The scene transitions to a top-down view on a wooden surface where hands wearing transparent plastic gloves are preparing raw fish. Sliced pieces of sea bass are placed into a clear glass bowl, followed by the addition of rice wine, salt, and cornstarch from small glass ramekins. The chef's hands mix the ingredients thoroughly to marinate the fish. A graphic list of ingredients is shown on a light gray background with clear Chinese text. (3) The chef then demonstrates the cooking process in a well-equipped kitchen. He is seen blanching the fish slices in a pot of boiling water and then using a yellow ceramic pot to fry ginger slices in dark sesame oil until they turn a golden yellow. He pours in rice wine and brings the mixture to a boil. A specific yellow and red product package from the 'Bullhead' brand is prominently displayed and then opened, with its liquid content poured into the soup pot. (4) In the final phase, the chef boils thin white noodles in a separate pot. He then assembles the dish by placing the noodles into a decorative ceramic bowl, adding the cooked fish, green vegetables, and the rich soup base. The chef holds the product package up to the camera, pointing at it while explaining its benefits. The video concludes with a close-up shot of the finished dish, looking warm and inviting under bright studio lights.
